# My SECOND example document

```{r include=FALSE}
library(devoirs3)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
devoirs3::devoirs_start(docID="thursday", feedback=TRUE, collector=TRUE)
```

This is the second example document.

```{r}
#| echo: false
# When only one answer is correct, use radio buttons.
Q1 <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "A14-satellite",
  question = "Which one is a satellite?",
  answers = list(
    list(text = "Mars $a \\equiv b$", correct = FALSE,
      feedback = "Sorry, it's a satellite of the Sun."),
    list(text = "Earth", correct = FALSE,
      feedback = "We live here. $\\int_0^1 \\pi dx$"),
    list(text = "Sun", correct = FALSE,
      feedback = "Bright, but not right!"),
    list(text = "Moon", correct = TRUE,
      feedback = "Right! Not big enough to be a planet.")
  )
)
```


```{r}
#| echo: false
# When multiple answers are correct, use checkboxes.
Q2 <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "A14-planets",
  question = "Which one(s) are planets?",
  multiple = TRUE,
  answers = list(
    list(text = "Mars", correct = TRUE,
      feedback = "Good!"),
    list(text = "Earth", correct = TRUE,
      feedback = "Our favorite planet. $\\pi r^2$"),
    list(text = "Sun", correct = FALSE,
      feedback = "Bright, but not right!"),
    list(text = "Moon", correct = FALSE,
      feedback = "Some people think it should be promoted.")
  )
)
```

A. Which one is a satellite? `r Q1(inline=TRUE, feedback=FALSE)`

B. Which one(s) are planets? `r Q2(inline=TRUE)`

C. Would you like to live on the Moon? Explain in detail why or why not.

`r devoirs_text(label = "A14-moon-live", question = "How about Mars?", height=5, width=80)`

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: A14_Q78
- "Yes":
    correct: TRUE
    feedback: Maybe
- "No":
    correct: FALSE
    feedback: "I'm rethinking this."
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
Q4 <- devoirs_selection(label="A14-right-thing", 
      question = "Is this the right thing to do?",
      answers = A14_Q78)
```


D. Is this the right thing to do? `r Q4(inline=FALSE)`

Thanks for participating!
